_doc: mic.py fast lane. Entries in priority order: the first whose keys match (whole words, any case; a space also matches a hyphen) wins, one reply per callout. Enemy counters never fire on a question or plan about your own play ("should I drop", "I need a banshee", fastlane.py); entries with "own": true are about you and always fire. Callouts longer than max_words are talk to the coach, not callouts: no fast reply. After editing a line, render its clip: live\.python\python.exe live\voice\render_fastlane.py

entries.line: Nydus. Army home, kill the worm before it unloads.
Drop. Pull SCVs, send a squad home.
Dark Templar. Turrets in the mineral lines, save a scan.
Banshee. Turrets in the mineral lines, keep a scan ready.
Proxy. Bunker the ramp, pull SCVs to hold.
Cannon rush. Pull SCVs, kill the Pylon first.
Banelings. Split your Marines, Dickie.
Mutas. Turrets in every mineral line, more Marines.
Oracle. Turret in the main mineral line, Marines home.
Roaches. Bunker at the natural, Marauders.
Lurkers. Scan first, then Tanks. Don't walk in.
Lings. Wall up, Bunker at the natural, Hellions out.
Ultras. Marauders and Ghosts, keep upgrading armor.
Brood Lords. Vikings now, hit before they mass.
Widow Mines. Scan ahead, spread out, don't ball up.
Sieged Tanks. Don't walk in. Flank wide or drop behind.
Liberator. Step out of the circle, Vikings on it.
Battlecruisers. Vikings with Marines, Turrets at home.
Disruptor. Spread out, back off the shot, then re-engage.
Colossus. Vikings now, keep them over your army.
Immortals. Go Marine heavy, add Ghosts, skip Tanks.
Air toss. Mass Vikings, add Thors, Turrets at home.
Blink Stalkers. Marauders, and watch the cliffs in your main.
Adepts. Marines in the mineral line, Bunker up.
Lots of Gateways. Bunker at the natural, hold, don't move out.
Reaper. Keep a Marine home, Bunker if it harasses.
Hellions. Wall the mineral line, Bunker or a Cyclone.
Two gas. Early tech coming. Bunker up, scout again.
One base. All-in coming. Bunker, extra Rax, hold, then punish.
Supply blocked. Two Depots, now.
Under attack. Army home, then counter.
Good game, Dickie. Breathe. Tell me the one thing that went wrong.
Well played. Tell me what worked.
Macro check. SCVs, Depots, spend the bank, then scout.
